signature.name: VTask.restrict
signature.type: {R : Type u_1} -> {R₂ : Type u_3} -> {M : Type u_5} -> {M₂ : Type u_7} -> [Semiring R] -> [Semiring R₂] -> [AddCommMonoid M] -> [AddCommMonoid M₂] -> [Module R M] -> [Module R₂ M₂] -> {σ₁₂ : R →+* R₂} -> (f : M →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] M₂) -> {p : Submodule R M} -> {q : Submodule R₂ M₂} -> (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) -> ↥p →ₛₗ[σ₁₂] ↥q

conventions.statement: The ring homomorphism σ₁₂ governing semilinearity is inherited unchanged from f; no new scalar structure is introduced by restricting to submodules.
conventions.note: This is a structural convention: the restriction does not alter the σ₁₂ parameter.

conventions.statement: When p = ⊤ and q = ⊤, VTask.restrict f hf is canonically equivalent to f itself.
conventions.note: Boundary convention: restricting to the whole module recovers the original map up to the top-submodule coercion.

facts.statement: ∀ (R M M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (p : Submodule R M) (q : Submodule R M₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) (x y : p), VTask.restrict f hf (x + y) = VTask.restrict f hf x + VTask.restrict f hf y

facts.statement: ∀ (R M M₂ : Type*) [CommSemiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (p : Submodule R M) (q : Submodule R M₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) (r : R) (x : p), VTask.restrict f hf (r • x) = r • VTask.restrict f hf x

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6; certified by the v1.2 kernel validation ladder

facts.statement: ∀ (R M M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (q : Submodule R M₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ (⊥ : Submodule R M), f x ∈ q), VTask.restrict f hf = 0

facts.statement: ∃ (h : ∀ x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℤ ℤ), (LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule ℤ ℤ)), Function.Injective (VTask.restrict (LinearMap.id : ℤ →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) h)

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ (R M M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (p : Submodule R M) (q : Submodule R M₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) (x : p), (VTask.restrict f hf x : M₂) = f (x : M) + f (x : M))

facts.statement: ¬ (∀ (R M M₂ : Type*) [Semiring R] [AddCommMonoid M] [AddCommMonoid M₂] [Module R M] [Module R M₂] (f : M →ₗ[R] M₂) (p : Submodule R M) (q : Submodule R M₂) (hf : ∀ x ∈ p, f x ∈ q) (x : p), (VTask.restrict f hf x : M₂) = (LinearMap.domRestrict f p x : M₂) + (LinearMap.domRestrict f p x : M₂))
